These are judgment estimates from my knowledge of NAS-Bench-201, not from querying the benchmark. Most claims need a consistent, practically sized interaction across all three datasets, so I've kept most probabilities low. Self-conditioned claims (3, 27) where the condition is the op being replaced are estimated low because replacing a stronger op usually costs more.
